units.source_text: “都酒店很近，她们是顺便来看看的。

en.t: The Miyako Hotel is very close, so they came to have a look while they were nearby.

units.source_text: 如果她们能仔细看看龙村的织品就好了，

en.t: It would have been nice if they had taken a careful look at Tatsumura's textiles,

units.source_text: 可惜只顾看小型收音机了。”

en.t: but unfortunately they were only interested in looking at the small radios.

units.source_text: “当然愿看什么全听她们的便。”

en.t: Of course, what they want to look at is entirely up to them.
